name: Mississippi

agency.name: Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality (MDEQ)
agency.division: Office of Pollution Control, Environmental Permits Division

overview: Mississippi requires a Permit to Construct for new facilities unless a facility-wide exclusion under Rule 2.13 applies. Construction permits are PSD (major), PSD-avoidance (moderate sources taking limits), or minor. Operating permits are Title V (Chapter 6), Synthetic Minor Operating Permits, or State Operating Permits for listed significant minor source types; true minor sources need no operating permit. MDEQ charges no air permit application fees; only Title V facilities pay annual fees.

permitTypes.name: Permit to Construct exclusions
permitTypes.description: Facility-wide exclusions under Rule 2.13.D and 2.13.E. The common Rule 2.13.D(5) exclusion does not apply to facilities with hazardous or solid waste incinerators or to CAFOs.
permitTypes.citation: 11 Miss. Admin. Code Pt. 2, Ch. 2, R. 2.13.D-E
permitTypes.thresholds: Per MDEQ (Rule 2.13.D(5)): facility-wide potential emissions below 10 tpy each of PM10, SO2, NOx, CO, and VOC; below 1.0 tpy any single HAP; below 2.5 tpy total HAPs.

permitTypes.name: General Permits
permitTypes.description: MDEQ lists an Oil Production General Permit under air general permits, and multimedia general permits such as the Hot-Mix Asphalt General Permit.

permitTypes.name: Permit to Construct (minor and PSD-avoidance)
permitTypes.description: Minor sources below PSD thresholds without limits need a Permit to Construct unless excluded; moderate sources take federally enforceable limits through a PSD-Avoidance Permit to Construct. De minimis modifications (below 3/4 of significance or major thresholds) have a simplified path. Pre-permit construction at the applicant's risk is available for some projects (Rule 2.15.B).

permitTypes.name: Synthetic Minor Operating Permit (SMOP) and State Operating Permit
permitTypes.description: SMOPs set federally enforceable limits to avoid Title V. State Operating Permits are required for listed significant minor source types (e.g., cotton gins, rendering plants) under Rule 2.1.C(25).

permitTypes.name: PSD Permit to Construct
permitTypes.description: Adopts 40 CFR 52.21 with some exceptions. MDEQ estimates 150+ days.

permitTypes.name: Title V Operating Permit (TVOP)
permitTypes.description: For major sources; revisions are administrative amendments, minor or significant modifications, or 502(b)(10) changes. Optional Title V modification path under Rule 2.15.C.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per MDEQ: potential emissions above 100 tpy of a criteria pollutant, 10 tpy of any single HAP, or 25 tpy of total HAPs.

oilAndGas.summary: MDEQ lists an Oil Production General Permit under its air general permits. No other oil-and-gas-specific air provisions were described in MDEQ's permitting guide.

programs.name: Oil Production General Permit
programs.description: Air general permit listed by MDEQ; details are on the general permits page.
